players.product: Precursors for memory (mainly DRAM) and advanced-logic fabs via UP Chemical (Korea) and Jiangsu Xianke (China), plus LDS liquid delivery systems

quarterly_data.quarter: Yoke Technology investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: it keeps a long-term, stable relationship with its major Korean memory customer, and its deliveries and supplier position with that customer remain stable. The Q2 precursor results of its Korean and domestic subsidiaries reflected only that quarter's delivery timing; over the long run UP Chemical (Korea) and Jiangsu Xianke are both in a healthy upward phase.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yoke Technology investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: its gross margin fell in Q2 2026 for two reasons: from April, the Middle East geopolitical situation disrupted the supply stability of upstream raw materials for chemicals and electronic materials, raising some raw-material prices and pressuring the supply chain; and deliveries of LNG insulation panels rose in Q2 versus Q1, weighing on the blended margin.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yoke Technology investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: as of the first half of 2026, overall utilisation of the precursor business rose moderately from the end of 2025. Utilisation moves mainly with downstream expansion and the release of new capacity, and is expected to keep improving from the second half of 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: precursor utilisation up moderately in H1 2026; expected to improve from H2 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Yoke Technology investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: since domestic base Jiangsu Xianke's new capacity came on stream over the past two years, part of the precursor business has been transferred from UP Chemical (Korea, acquired in 2016) to Jiangsu Xianke, which has affected UP Chemical's sales; with fabs' new capacity being released, both are expected to enter a healthy growth phase. Its molybdenum dioxide dichloride is still at the R&D trial-production and capacity-planning stage.

Yoke Technology.why: Supplies precursors to memory fabs (mainly DRAM makers) through its Korean subsidiary UP Chemical and Jiangsu Xianke; precursor volumes rise with DRAM/HBM capacity expansion.
Yoke Technology.evidence: Yoke Technology IR activity record 2026-002 (09-09-2026): the company's semiconductor-materials customers are concentrated in memory, mainly DRAM wafer makers; main memory-fab customers plan to double capacity in 3-5 years and the company is expanding precursor capacity in China and Korea.
